user.title: Connect to CTC Heat Pump
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP connection details and select the CTC product family. The model is not detected automatically.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the heat pump.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The default is 502.
data_description.slave_id: Modbus slave ID. CTC defaults to 1.
data_description.model: Choose the family listed in the CTC BMS code table. GSi 612 is represented by the GSi / CTC GS family. Choose Other / not listed if unsure.

init.title: CTC model
init.description: Change the product family selected for this heat pump.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the heat pump.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.
